role: @MainActor XCTest suite for the app-owned half of the strap HR subscription: StrapHeartRateFeed.desiredKind (PPI only for a Verity Sense in session) and StrapHeartRateFeed.drain over synthetic AsyncThrowingStreams (order, empty stream, failure after samples, cancellation).
types: Boom: private struct Error used as a synthetic stream failure

units.does: Test helper: AsyncThrowingStream that yields each of `values` synchronously then finishes, throwing `error` if given.

branches.effect: yields it to the continuation before finishing

units.does: Asserts desiredKind is .ppi only for veritySense with sessionActive true; .heartRate for Verity outside a session, H10 in session, and nil device.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts drain over [1..5] delivers 1,2,3,4,5 in order, reports samples 5 and no error.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts drain over an empty stream delivers nothing, samples 0, error nil.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts drain over [1,2] then Boom delivers 1 and 2, samples 2, and error is Boom.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Drains an endless 2 ms producer on a MainActor task, waits (≤5 s) for the first element, cancels the feed task, then asserts no further element is delivered within 100 ms; finally cancels the producer.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: yields an incrementing value every 2 ms; finishes the stream once cancelled
true on the first element: fulfils the 'delivery started' expectation; false afterwards

units.does: Cancels a feed task draining a 3-element stream immediately and asserts at most 3 elements were delivered and pass.samples equals the delivered count.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: XCTAssertLessThanOrEqual(received.count, 3) cannot fail for a 3-element source whatever drain does on cancellation, so the test only checks samples == received.count; the 'delivers nothing further' behaviour in its name is not asserted.
